reasoning: On the season so far the Thunder are the stronger team; with home court the Thunder start about 7 points better, in a game of about 225 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Hawks.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Hawks.
Bottom line: the Thunder win 63 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 200 and 249 total points.

analyst.text: Lu Dort and Aaron Wiggins return to Oklahoma City for the first time since leaving the title team for Atlanta, so expect an emotional night. The Thunder are without Jalen Williams, Chet Holmgren and Cason Wallace, but Shai Gilgeous-Alexander has scored 40 and 37 in his last two. The angle leans towards the Thunder, with some extra fire from the returning Hawks.
